total_model.summary: Model projects 45.4 total points (DET 22, MIN 23). Biggest factors: Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (lowers total 1.2), Divisional game (lowers total 0.7), Combined defense EPA allowed/play (recent-weighted) (raises total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
